reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That figure comes from Dana's own post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Dana is in. She first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. The amendment was signed Aug 19. I couldn't open the signed amendment in any file Dana can see, so I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to check before the deck goes out. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.

The gbrain search was refused with "requester_scope_required": its token isn't tied to any member, so nothing was read from it. Someone with admin access to the brain host needs to fix the token's scope before the brain can be used for member questions. I didn't try to change it myself.
